Coastal Waters Forecast
National Weather Service Honolulu HI
436 PM HST Sat Jul 25 2026

Hawaiian coastal waters within 40 nautical miles including the
Hawaiian Islands Humpback Whale National Marine Sanctuary.

PHZ100-261515-
436 PM HST Sat Jul 25 2026

.Synopsis for Hawaiian coastal waters...
Locally strong trades persist through Sunday. Winds will ease and
shift to northeasterly on Monday. Hurricane Fausto is forecast to
weaken into a tropical storm before it passes near the islands
Tuesday and Wednesday.
